description: Abstract closeup composition of three mountain flowers floating above a sea of green with puffs of white yarrow and orange Indian paintbrush flower fragments.  Floating like a pinwheel in the foreground is a pink mariposa lily with a yellow and ruby center housing the pistils and the stamens. Floating above the mariposa lily are two abstract lavender lilies.
title: Mountain Flowers II/Mariposa Lily – Pink
